series.description: One ridge per series, drawn top to bottom. Values are raw observations; the ridge is their kernel density.

label.description: What is measured. Names the chart for assistive technology.

unit.description: Unit after each value, such as "°" or " ms".

domain.description: Value range of the axis. Fix it to keep the axis still across datasets. Defaults to the data with room on each side.

overlap.description: How far the tallest ridge rises into the rows above, in row heights.

rowHeight.description: Height of one row in pixels.

bandwidth.description: Smoothing in value units. Defaults to Silverman's rule per series.

tint.description: Shades each ridge by its median, from a light tint to the full first series color, with a stepped scale under the axis.

active.description: Controlled id of the lifted ridge.

onActiveChange.description: Called when the lifted ridge changes.

emptyLabel.description: Shown when there are no values.
